tasks.story: When a user pasted nodes onto the canvas or imported a workflow (for example a JSON export from another instance or one shared by a colleague), the nodes arrived with no credential attached and immediately showed missing-credential warnings, even when the instance already had a perfectly usable credential of the right type. The user had to open every node one by one just to pick the credential that would have been auto-selected anyway when adding the node manually. Make the editor pick a sensible existing credential automatically for such credential-less nodes, while deliberately skipping generic HTTP request authentication where a silent guess would likely be wrong, and inform the user which credential was chosen so they can verify it.

tasks.story: The insights dashboard decides what the current day and each day boundary mean using the server's own UTC clock rather than the clock of the person looking at the page. A viewer outside UTC asking for a date range gets a window shifted off the days they actually picked, so the numbers do not match the selected period; related integration coverage was also flaky depending on when and in which timezone it ran, near midnight or at range edges. Make the day-boundary decision honor the caller's timezone so requested ranges line up with the viewer's calendar days.

tasks.story: Data table row endpoints let callers ask for a preview of which rows an operation would affect without actually changing the table. For row deletion, that preview request was not honored: a request marked as preview-only still permanently removed every matching row, so users and workflow nodes asking to see what would happen destroyed their data instead. Make the delete endpoint honor the preview flag, reporting which rows would have been removed while leaving the table untouched.
